about_the_game:
Step into Zombeo & Vampireta, a visual novel that blends dark humor with a touch of horror in a world where the dead refuse to rest. Inspired by the classic tragedy of Romeo and Juliet, this story takes a modern, twisted, and entertaining spin on eternal love and family feuds.

Make choices and shape your fate as you play in a society torn by the endless war between two powerful families: the Muertesco and the Sanguileto, locked in a battle for control over Mortánima, the cemetery realm.

Play as Zombeo Muertesco, a shy young zombie thrust into adventure and destiny, or as Vampireta Sanguileto, a vampire as alluring as she is dangerous, living out a unique experience where forbidden emotions stir within your rotten heart.

Explore Mortánima, a graveyard full of chaos, secrets, and unexpected twists—where every corner hides a new surprise.

Face decisions that will alter your destiny—and the fate of those you care about. Every choice can lead you down a path of eerie laughs, macabre romance, or tragic consequences.

Will you dare to defy the laws of the afterlife and fight for love in the midst of war?

Play the demo now and discover everything this haunting story has to offer!
Get ready for a unique mix of horror, humor, and unexpected turns!

short_description: Zombeo and Vampiretta is a short visual novel about impossible love and corpses full of life Play as a romantic zombie or a foul-mouthed vampiress in a family feud fueled by centuries of resentment—and the stench of death. Discover in this demo how far a love story between two hopeful undead can go.
